subject: bio
title: The carbon cycle

stages.label: Carbon dioxide in the air
stages.description: Carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, taken in by plants and given out by respiration.

stages.label: Plants
stages.description: Photosynthesis turns carbon dioxide into glucose and other carbon compounds.

stages.label: Animals
stages.description: Animals take in carbon compounds when they eat plants or other animals.

stages.label: Dead matter and waste
stages.description: Dead plants and animals and their waste still hold carbon compounds.

stages.label: Decomposers
stages.description: Bacteria and fungi feed on dead matter and release carbon dioxide by respiration.
